name: Discovery Set
title: Discovery Set
description: Curated to showcase a selection of Batlah’s most defining fragrances, the set reflects the brand’s commitment to craft, balance, and intentional selection. Each scent is presented not as an individual product, but as part of a broader narrative shaped by heritage and refinement. Designed for exploration rather than trend, the Discovery Set oﬀers a measured way to experience the Batlah house philosophy.

name: Turquoise
title: Turquoise
description: Captures the warmth of sunlight and turquoise waters of the Red Sea

name: Aqua
title: Aqua
description: The silver lining between water & ice, the crisp of a fresh morning breeze

name: Winter Mist
title: Winter Mist
description: A poetic dance of frost and light. This fragrance opens with a sharp burst of icy citrus—crisp bergamot and frosted lemon—evoking the last breath of winter air

name: Flora
title: Flora
description: A smooth blend of floral and citrus notes creates a delicate and refreshing fragrance, leaving a lasting impression.

name: Sunshower
title: Sunshower
description: Capturing the sunrise essence, this fragrance blends invigorating florals with a warm, musky base.

name: Bois de santal
title: Bois de santal
description: A harmonious fusion of Sandalwood and Cardamom unveils a warm, woody core.

name: Cashmere
title: Cashmere
description: A harmonious fusion of floral and spicy accords, with a woody base. Iris and Pepper intertwine, while Musk and Ambrette Seeds provide a warm embrace, evoking Cashmere comfort.

name: Snow & Spice
title: Snow & Spice
description: A delightful blend of freshness and spices creates a rich and warm olfactory experience.

name: Arabian Knight
title: Arabian Knight
description: With a harmonious blend of spices and citrus that rests atop a warm base of Vanilla and Wood, this fragrance evokes the essence of an Arabian knight.

name: Feminine muse
title: Feminine muse
description: A uniquely feminine fragrance, this blend offers a captivating fusion of delicate florals and warm, sensual notes of Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Musk not musk
title: Musk not musk
description: Musk Not Musk captures the familiar sensuality of musk—but without synthetic musks. Crafted solely from natural flowers, seeds, and botanical resins, it reimagines musk through nature’s lens. A soft, skin-like scent—pure, intimate, and entirely natural.

name: Oud accord
title: Oud accord
description: Using the heart of Batlah’s finest essential oils and natural ingredients, we created a limited number of this perfume to celebrate the passion and elegance of perfumery.

name: Nahar
title: Nahar
description: It captures the essence of serene mornings. The delicate balance of Frankincense and Rose creates a soothing and uplifting aroma. With each inhale, Nahar imparts a gentle, calming sensation, promoting tranquility and kindness.

name: Diriyah
title: Diriyah
description: A harmonious blend of Rose and Oud creates Diriyah, a fragrance uniquely tied to the first Saudi state. Its composition, inspired by the historic Oud trade route, exudes a regal aura, reflecting its exceptional and distinctive character.

name: Heritage
title: Heritage
description: Heralded as a royal heirloom, this fragrance boasts a century-old formula. Composed of the finest Oud, Musk, and Rose, it has been passed down through generations, symbolizing a rich cultural legacy.

name: Taif Rose
title: Taif Rose
description: The Taif rose. It is known for its potent scent through the centuries and across different cultures, due to the difficult terrain and its blooming despite it. Additionally, the need to distill one million roses to produce only one liter of this exquisite oil. Batlah took upon itself the responsibility of presenting the Taif rose oil in its finest natural qualities and reflecting Saudi Arabia's visible cultural heritage.
